# EV.ENGINEER

> EV.ENGINEER is an engineering-education platform and brand publishing
> content, internships and student project tracks in EV battery systems,
> Battery Management Systems, automotive and battery cybersecurity,
> autonomous vehicle systems, and aerospace and space engineering
> (including a model rocketry learning guide). The site is operated by
> iTelematics Software Private Limited. EV Society is a separate community
> initiative that stewards the Space Initiative; EV.ENGINEER and EV Society
> are distinct entities and are not merged here.

This file is an experimental discovery aid for AI agents and language
models. It is not a replacement for crawlable HTML, structured data
(JSON-LD), the XML sitemap, or conventional SEO — see those first. Every
link below points to a canonical public page already listed in
/sitemap.xml.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/): Lithium-Ion EV Battery
  Intelligence Platform — overview of EV.ENGINEER.
- [About](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/about): What EV.ENGINEER builds
  and its focus areas.
- [Internships](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships): Canonical hub
  for EV, battery, cybersecurity, autonomous-systems, aerospace, space and
  model-rocketry internships and student projects.
- [AegisCAN](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/AegisCAN): 12-week
  educational R&D mini-project on Battery, BMS, BESS, CAN communication,
  validation, fault injection and CAN cybersecurity. Initiated and led by
  Tanuja Jadhav (Lead Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™), with Bhavya Naga Sai
  Parvathi Kshatri (Cybersecurity Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™), Harsh Yadav
  (Co-Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™, aerospace cybersecurity research and
  AS9102 First Article Inspection engineering focus) and Sudarshana Karkala
  (Co-Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™).
- [Sudarshana Karkala](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/about/sudarshana-karkala):
  Canonical public professional profile — verified role, focus areas,
  initiatives and contact channels.
- [Contact](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/contact): Public business
  contact details for iTelematics Software Private Limited.
- [Trust Center](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/trust-center): Verified
  feedback and professional recognition, used as the evidence destination
  for claims made across this site.

## Space and aerospace

- [Space](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/space): EV Society's aerospace
  and space-engineering education initiative.
- [Model Rocketry Learning Guide](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/space/2026-INSPACe-ROCKETRY-059):
  An independent, beginner-friendly seven-day model rocketry guide. Not an
  official IN-SPACe or ISRO publication.

## Entity distinctions

- EV.ENGINEER: platform/brand, not a separate registered legal entity.
- iTelematics Software Private Limited: the legal company operating
  EV.ENGINEER, per /contact.
- EV Society: a separate community initiative, not a registered Section 8
  company per any evidence published on this site.
- Sudarshana Karkala: a person — founder of EV.ENGINEER, Co-Founder of
  Thasmai Infotech Private Limited, and a consultant to iTelematics
  Software Private Limited.
- IN-SPACe and ISRO: external government organisations referenced only as
  the publisher of the model-rocketry workshop this site's learning guide
  is based on. No endorsement, certification or partnership is implied.

## Public source documentation referenced by this site

- [IN-SPACe Workshop on Essentials of Model Rocketry](https://www.inspace.gov.in/inspace?id=workshop_on_essentials_of_model_rocketry)

## CubeTwin

- [CubeTwin](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/cubesat): EV Society educational R&D CubeSat energy simulator, 12-week guide and printable workbook. Simulated data; not flight software.

## Satellite Engineering

- [Satellite Engineering](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering): An EV.ENGINEER advanced 12-week Architecture & Leadership Track, "From First Principles to Spacecraft Systems Architect", within the EV Society Space initiative, for systems leads, principal engineers, engineering managers, CTOs, chief architects and senior R&D engineers. Covers mission system-of-systems architecture, spacecraft subsystem architecture, engineering budgets and margin policy, architecture decision records, software assurance, EEE parts and product assurance, a satellite digital twin (an engineering model, not a validated flight twin), a CubeSat-class educational flatsat (not flight-qualified), and formal review gates in lifecycle order (MCR, SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, ORR, MRR). Completion does not confer job titles.
- [Satellite Explorer 3D](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering/interactive-3d): Interactive 3D model of an educational 6U Earth-observation reference satellite. Build the spacecraft, open it in exploded and X-ray views, follow power, data and RF flows, and run an end-to-end mission from boot to payload downlink. Reference and simulated values; not flight hardware or a real mission. The full 3D experience is designed for laptop and desktop screens; phones get a compact subsystem overview.

## Rocket Engine Digital Twin

- [Next-Generation Rocket Engine Digital Twin](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/rocket-engine-digital-twin): An EV.ENGINEER interactive digital-engineering learning environment for a reusable liquid rocket engine reference architecture. Covers the propellant feed system, turbomachinery, combustion chamber, regenerative cooling, nozzle, valves and actuation, instrumentation, engine control, simulated engine testing, engine health monitoring, fault diagnosis and the observed, estimated, expected and predicted digital twin states. Reference and simulated values; not a real, production or flight engine, and not correlated with test data.
